title: Normality of lower bound cluster algebras defined by quivers
author: Greg Muller; Jenna Rajchgot; Bradley Zykoski
work: Lower bound cluster algebras: presentations, Cohen-Macaulayness, and normality
difficulty_reason: After ordinary Serre normality criteria, squarefree Groebner degeneration facts and the cited Knutson--Lam--Speyer criterion, the author still constructs the cycle presentation and proves the vertex-decomposable ball/sphere model. The proof then identifies intersections of extraneous prime components with the lower-bound component as precisely the boundary sphere and analyzes the normal open locus through freezing and cycle-polynomial affine spaces. These source-local degeneration, boundary and open-locus arguments supply research-level residual obligations beyond routine doctoral qualification exercises.

contexts.scope: Complete authored mathematical body and support; uncounted appendices
